title: Lathe Publish Manifest v1
description: Manifest emitted by the publish runner (BL-31, Plan 08 Phase 1). Pinned shape returned by PublishDriver.publish(...) and written to manifest.json alongside uploaded artifacts.

stack_id.description: Backend stack id that produced this build (e.g. lathe.stack.hard_surface_game_asset_v1).

shape_contract.description: Stable shape-stage contract id. Defaults to lathe.shape.intent_mesh_handoff_v1.

package_formats.description: One entry per packaged artifact (usd / glb / gltf / obj).

validator_scores.description: Snapshot of validate-stage report (may be empty if not present).

git_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD inside the build directory, or null if unavailable.

sbom.description: Relative path to an SBOM file (e.g. sbom.json) if present.

value_hex.description: Hex-encoded signature bytes. Present only when signing succeeded.

skipped_reason.description: Explanation when signing was skipped (no_signing_key_configured, cryptography_not_installed, signing_key_missing, invalid_signing_key:*).
